[attribute-accredit-acronym]
=== `@accredit-acronym` Accreditation Acronym

Names the accrediting organization, for example, United States SDOs can name “`ANSI`”. This attribute provides a machine-searchable normalized version of the organization since the content of the <<element-accrediting-organization,`<accrediting-organization>`>> element is free form.

#### Usage/Remarks
##### Best Practice

Since the attribute name includes the word “acronym”, the values (such as “`ANSI`”) should be given in ALL CAPS.

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-accrediting-organization,`<accrediting-organization>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| An acronym that names the accrediting organization referenced in the <<element-accrediting-organization,`<accrediting-organization>`>> element.
| Restriction| This attribute is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===

#### Tagged Sample

##### Part of `<std-meta>`
[source,xml]
....
...
<std-meta>
 ...
 <comm-ref>...</comm-ref>
 <accrediting-organization accredit-acronym="ANSI">Under the 
  authority of the American National Standards Institute</accrediting-organization>
 <authorization authorize-acronym="ANS">An American National 
  Standard</authorization>
 <secretariat>...</secretariat>
</std-meta>
...
....
